mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positively impacted over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.05 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and efficiency, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 55% of non-recessionary quarters with positive INDPRO growth, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 6-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with no specific trigger condition.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.035 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 45% of months with positive HOUST growth.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds a 3-month average increase of 0.5%, indicating heightened inflation concerns, and FEDFUNDS is above 3%, investors anticipate monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.04 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in UNRATE below 3.5%, coupled with RSAFS showing a monthly increase of > $500M, signals robust labor market conditions and increased consumer spending, positively impacting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances, or joint proxy Rank IC < 0.03 over any 4-year rolling window.
